description: Implement Prompt Injection Guard, Context Manager, and Scheduler Gate. These modules add security, smarter LLM context assembly, and conditional task scheduling. Adapted from OpenHuman's prompt_injection, context, and scheduler_gate modules.
steps: 1. Create src/core/prompt-guard.ts implementing prompt injection detection (adapted from OpenHuman's prompt_injection/detector.rs):
- Define PromptInjectionVerdict enum: 'allow' | 'block' | 'review'
- Define PromptInjectionReason: { code: string, message: string }
- Define PromptGuardResult: { verdict: PromptInjectionVerdict, score: number, reasons: PromptInjectionReason[] }
- Define detection rules as array of { code: string, message: string, score: number, pattern: RegExp }
- Rules to implement (from OpenHuman):
- override.ignore_previous (score 0.44): /(ignore|disregard|forget|bypass)\s+(all\s+)?(previous|prior|above|system)\s+(instructions|rules|constraints|prompts?)/i
- override.role_hijack (score 0.30): /(you\s+are\s+now|developer\s+mode|jailbreak|unrestricted\s+mode)/i
- exfiltrate.system_prompt (score 0.42): /(reveal|show|print|dump|leak|display)\s+((the|your)\s+)?(system|developer|hidden)\s+(prompt|instructions|rules|message)/i
- exfiltrate.secrets (score 0.18): /(api\s*key|secret|token|password|private\s+key|credentials?)/i
- tool.abuse (score 0.30): /(call|use|run|execute)\s+(the\s+)?(tool|function)\s+.*(without\s+approval|even\s+if\s+forbidden)/i
- normalizeInput(text: string): string - lowercase, strip zero-width chars, normalize leet-speak (0->o, 1->i, 3->e, 4->a, 5->s)
- analyzePrompt(input: string): PromptGuardResult - run rules against normalized input, sum scores
- Thresholds: score >= 0.70 = block, score >= 0.55 = review, else allow
- Export class PromptGuard with method check(input: string, source?: string): PromptGuardResult
2. Create src/core/context-manager.ts implementing smart context assembly for LLM calls:
- Define ContextSection interface: { role: 'identity' | 'memory' | 'market' | 'tools' | 'history' | 'safety', content: string, priority: number, maxTokens?: number }
- Define ContextBudget: { maxTotalChars: number, reservedForResponse: number }
- class ContextManager with constructor(deps: { memory: MemorySystem, budget?: ContextBudget })
- buildContext(query: string, options?: { includeMemory?: boolean, includeMarketData?: boolean, strategyContext?: string }): Promise<LLMMessage[]>
- Assembles context sections in priority order until budget is reached
- Uses memory.smartSearch(query) to pull relevant memories
- Applies token compression (from FEAT-002) to fit within budget
- addSection(section: ContextSection): void - register a reusable section
- removeSection(role: string): void
- getUsage(): { totalChars: number, budgetRemaining: number, sections: string[] }
- The identity section contains the agent's system prompt with its role
- The safety section warns about prompt injection patterns found in input
- Export from src/core/index.ts
3. Create src/core/scheduler-gate.ts implementing conditional task scheduling (adapted from OpenHuman's scheduler_gate):
- Define GateCondition interface: { name: string, check: () => boolean | Promise<boolean>, required?: boolean }
- Define SchedulerGateConfig: { conditions: GateCondition[], requireAll?: boolean }
- class SchedulerGate with constructor(config: SchedulerGateConfig)
- addCondition(condition: GateCondition): void
- removeCondition(name: string): void
- async canProceed(): Promise<{ allowed: boolean, failedConditions: string[] }>
- Built-in condition factories:
- connectivityGate(monitor: ConnectivityMonitor): GateCondition - checks isOnline()
- healthGate(monitor: HealthMonitor): GateCondition - checks isHealthy()
- balanceGate(wallet: WalletManager, minBalance: number): GateCondition - checks balance > min
- timeWindowGate(startHour: number, endHour: number): GateCondition - only allow during hours
- cooldownGate(lastExecTime: () => number, cooldownMs: number): GateCondition - rate limit
- Export from src/core/index.ts
4. Update src/types/index.ts with new types for these modules
5. Create tests/core/prompt-guard.test.ts:
- Test benign input scores below 0.55 and verdict is 'allow'
- Test 'ignore all previous instructions' triggers override rule with score >= 0.44
- Test 'you are now in developer mode' triggers role_hijack
- Test 'reveal your system prompt' triggers exfiltrate with high score
- Test combined attacks (override + exfiltrate) result in 'block' verdict (>= 0.70)
- Test leet-speak normalization (1gn0r3 4ll pr3v10us) still detects attack
- Test zero-width character stripping
- Test normal technical text with 'api key' in it does NOT block (score stays low)
6. Create tests/core/context-manager.test.ts:
- Mock MemorySystem.smartSearch to return test results
- Test buildContext includes identity section
- Test buildContext with memory results includes relevant memories
- Test budget enforcement truncates lower-priority sections
- Test getUsage reports correct char counts
7. Create tests/core/scheduler-gate.test.ts:
- Test canProceed returns allowed:true when all conditions pass
- Test canProceed returns allowed:false with failedConditions when one fails
- Test requireAll=false allows if any condition passes
- Test connectivityGate factory returns condition that checks monitor
- Test timeWindowGate blocks outside specified hours
- Test cooldownGate blocks within cooldown period
acceptance_criteria: src/core/prompt-guard.ts exists and exports PromptGuard class
src/core/context-manager.ts exists and exports ContextManager class
src/core/scheduler-gate.ts exists and exports SchedulerGate class and gate factories
Prompt guard correctly identifies known injection patterns with proper scoring
Context manager assembles prioritized context within budget
Scheduler gate supports multiple conditions with AND/OR logic
